posts: Tracked a live bass line over last night's drum sketch and it finally clicks. Rough mix goes up on near.fm later today — feedback welcome. #nearfm #music
Production note: when a mix feels crowded, delete a track before reaching for EQ. Less is more, even at 140bpm. New one loading on #nearfm.

replies.text: Iterations beat hesitations works in the studio too — I ship a rough loop every Friday even when it's not 'ready.' Small ships, big waves indeed.
GM! Coffee's poured, session's booked — new beat drops on near.fm this week.
